inputs.checklistItemText: Underground utility lines (existing and proposed) not shown on applicable sheets (BAS-14b)
inputs.question: Are proposed underground utility lines (such as proposed water, wastewater, storm drain, gas, or underground electric lines) shown on this Overall Utility Plan sheet?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether proposed underground utility lines appear on the sheet at all (presence/sheet-discovery check), not whether they are drawn with specific symbols, line styles, or spatial relationships. This is a feature-presence question that precedes any drawing-inspection or measurement task.
